headline: MAGIC CARPET: the campaign grows to twenty-seven worlds
lede: The never-dry lane found Magic Carpet weakest on the shelf and grew its campaign a third: nine new worlds across arcs seven to nine, the farthest vault yet at quota 535, and every seed still brings every world home.

notes.text: Nine named worlds IRONWOOD to THE FARTHEST SKY join the campaign, each arc closing on the SKY trio and on frost — the three-atmosphere cycle needed no new laws, the select/cursor/HUD all already rode the table length.

The deeper arcs ride pearls at +5/world: the old +4 step would have demanded 93% of realistic pearl yield at world 27, where mid-campaign asks 89% — the economy policy now lives in a machine pin (quota <= 3.5x pearls, every world).
Sweep caps ride the campaign (LEVELS.length * 26000 ticks): the slowest seed needs 508,702 ticks at 27 worlds, and the old fixed 300k was already ~88% eaten at eighteen. 60/60 seeds win all 27.
The cursor-wrap gate hard-coded ±18 and would have passed WRONG at any other world count — re-proven generically (±n round-trips + full cycles both directions).
